title: Independent-set hardness with a three-colorability promise
exact_target: For every fixed $\delta \in (0,1/3)$, can 3SAT be reduced in deterministic polynomial time to a nonempty finite simple unweighted graph so that satisfiable formulas yield three-colorable graphs and unsatisfiable formulas yield graphs with independence number $<\delta $ times the vertex count?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.

manuscripts.title: Hardness of finding large independent sets in three-colorable graphs
